messages.author: 71cefeaaa3659875
messages.subject: Re: Error in *titan_correctreads.R
parts:
Hi Jasleen,

Can you please check that the gc, map, tumor, and normal wig files all have the same number of rows?  The function does some checks for extra chromosomes but it's safer to just ensure that each row in all 4 files correspond to the same 1kb bin coordinates.

Let me know if that helps.

Best,
Gavin

messages.author: 032df22a0c0d5e56
messages.subject: Re: Error in *titan_correctreads.R
parts:
Hi Gavin,

Figured it out. Sorry, but it was an oversight on my part. There was a mistake in the reference file - I was using hg19 Lite instead of hg18 Lite. Thankyou for your help!

Best,
Jasleen.
